ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read the diagram of the “atmospheric heating process.” <image1> In the atmospheric heating process shown in the diagram, the trend of global temperature change over the past hundred years is related to what change in which link?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the diagram, the left side is the “Sun,” the middle is the “ground,” and on the right side there are the “atmosphere” and “space.” Solar radiation reaches the ground through the arrow labeled ②; the ground emits radiation to the atmosphere; the atmosphere has an arrow labeled ④ returning to the ground, and another arrow labeled ③ pointing to space. Then reason: the trend of change in global temperature over the past nearly one hundred years mentioned in the question stem refers to global warming. Global warming is related to the enhancement of the greenhouse effect, and its direct manifestation is that after the atmosphere absorbs terrestrial long-wave radiation, atmospheric counter-radiation is enhanced. In the diagram, ④ represents atmospheric counter-radiation, so ④ enhanced should be filled in.
